svg.text: x' uses a c-like candidate from MV-close conductance midpoint to Ao-flow onset. AoEnd→MVmid uses QAo zero crossing to MV-open conductance midpoint; neither is clinical IVRT. Censored y is a lower bound.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: effective event→Ca-like delay: event boundary remains theta=0.776; 15 ms=complete-fusion/absent Ar, 30 ms=complete-fusion/absent Ar. Delay alone does not separate E/A or generate Ar.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: LV activation-state fall: 40→30 ms moves MV-conductance midpoint to theta=0.545 and Ao-flow-end→MV-mid 120 ms→91 ms; y=2.679 interior, MV=partial-fusion, A/v=multiple-self-intersections.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: The flow-end interval is neither clinical IVRT nor invasive LV pressure tau.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: PV series R: +25% gives x'=0.963 mmHg and QPV nadir=79.8 mL/s, but Ar=absent. Local R alone is insufficient; no C/L/source/MV compensation was applied.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Decision: the post-MV-close-conductance-midpoint rise resolves as boundary-at-aortic-flow-onset; c→x monotonicity=95.8%.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not gate strict MV-close-conductance-midpoint→x monotonicity. The later pressure-flow contract separates event timing from conductance but still does not establish leaflet contact or clinical IVRT.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Generated from work-conjugate-atrial-av-plane-report-v1; c-wave, IVRT, E/A, y, PV Ar, and topology rows are diagnostics rather than clinical validation.
